owasp_source: OWASP Top 10:2021, danh sach 'List of Mapped CWEs' tai https://top10.owasp.org/2021/ (kiem tra ngay 2026-10-16)

priority.formula: score = round(100 * severity_weight * min(1, 0.5*sast + 0.5*p_model + bonus)); sast = 1 neu SAST bao dung lop, nguoc lai 0; p_model = xac suat CodeBERT cho lop (0 neu khong goi mo hinh); bonus = agreement_bonus neu SAST bao lop va lop co xac suat cao nhat cua CodeBERT trung lop do

SQL_INJECTION.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

remediation.summary: Dung truy van tham so hoa (prepared statement/placeholder); khong ghep chuoi hay format du lieu nguoi dung vao cau SQL. Ten bang/cot dong phai lay tu danh sach cho phep.
remediation.Python: cursor.execute("SELECT ... WHERE id = %s", (user_id,)); voi ORM dung filter()/params, tranh raw()/extra() voi chuoi da format.
remediation.Java: PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement("SELECT ... WHERE id = ?"); ps.setInt(1, id); voi JPA dung tham so dat ten (:id).
remediation.JavaScript: Dung placeholder cua driver (db.query('SELECT ... WHERE id = ?', [id])) hoac query builder/ORM; khong dung template literal de tao SQL.
remediation.PHP: PDO: $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT ... WHERE id = :id'); $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]); khong noi bien vao chuoi SQL.

XSS.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

remediation.summary: Ma hoa dau ra theo ngu canh (HTML, thuoc tinh, JavaScript, URL); bat autoescape cua template; chi cho phep HTML qua thu vien sanitize; them Content-Security-Policy.
remediation.Python: De Jinja2/Django tu escape; khong dung mark_safe/Markup/|safe voi du lieu nguoi dung; dung format_html() hoac markupsafe.escape(); sanitize HTML bang bleach/nh3.
remediation.Java: Dung template tu escape (Thymeleaf th:text) hoac OWASP Java Encoder (Encode.forHtml); sanitize bang OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer.
remediation.JavaScript: Gan textContent thay vi innerHTML; khong dung dangerouslySetInnerHTML/v-html voi du lieu chua sach; sanitize bang DOMPurify.
remediation.PHP: echo htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); dung template tu escape (Twig, Blade {{ }}).

OS_COMMAND_INJECTION.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

remediation.summary: Tranh goi shell; dung API cua ngon ngu/thu vien thay lenh he thong; neu bat buoc chay tien trinh thi truyen danh sach doi so, them '--' truoc doi so tu nguoi dung va kiem tra theo danh sach cho phep.
remediation.Python: subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", host], check=True) voi shell=False; khong dung os.system/os.popen; neu can chuoi thi shlex.quote().
remediation.Java: new ProcessBuilder("ping", "-c", "1", host) thay vi Runtime.exec(String); kiem tra host theo regex cho phep.
remediation.JavaScript: child_process.execFile('ping', ['-c', '1', host]) hoac spawn khong shell; khong dung exec() voi chuoi ghep.
remediation.PHP: Tranh exec/system/shell_exec/backticks; neu bat buoc dung escapeshellarg() cho tung doi so.

PATH_TRAVERSAL.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

remediation.summary: Chuan hoa duong dan (realpath/resolve) roi kiem tra no van nam trong thu muc goc cho phep; uu tien anh xa ID -> file thay vi nhan ten file tu nguoi dung; giai nen archive co loc thanh vien.
remediation.Python: p = (BASE / name).resolve(); kiem tra p.is_relative_to(BASE.resolve()); dung werkzeug safe_join/send_from_directory; tarfile.extractall(path, filter='data').
remediation.Java: Path p = base.resolve(name).normalize(); if (!p.startsWith(base)) throw ...; kiem tra ten entry khi giai nen ZIP (Zip Slip).
remediation.JavaScript: const p = path.resolve(base, name); if (!p.startsWith(base + path.sep)) throw ...; dung express.static/res.sendFile voi tuy chon root.
remediation.PHP: $p = realpath($base . '/' . $name); if ($p === false || strpos($p, $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) { ... }; basename() cho ten file.

remediation.summary: Dung co che xac thuc/framework da kiem chung; xac minh chu ky va thoi han token; so sanh bi mat bang ham thoi gian hang so; gioi han so lan dang nhap; tao lai session sau dang nhap; kiem tra xac thuc o moi endpoint nhay cam.
remediation.Python: jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=["HS256"]) khong tat verify; hmac.compare_digest() de so sanh; Django: login_required, rotate session (login() da lam); gioi han dang nhap (django-axes).
remediation.Java: Spring Security cho xac thuc/phan quyen; xac minh JWT bang thu vien (jjwt) voi khoa va thuat toan co dinh; MessageDigest.isEqual() de so sanh.
remediation.JavaScript: jsonwebtoken.verify(token, key, { algorithms: ['HS256'] }); crypto.timingSafeEqual(); passport/middleware xac thuc cho moi route; regenerate session sau login.
remediation.PHP: password_hash/password_verify; hash_equals() de so sanh token; session_regenerate_id(true) sau dang nhap; gioi han so lan thu.

remediation.summary: Xoa bi mat khoi ma nguon va lich su git, thu hoi/doi bi mat da lo; doc tu bien moi truong hoac secret manager (Vault, AWS/GCP/Azure Secret Manager); quet bi mat trong CI (gitleaks, trufflehog).
remediation.Python: password = os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"]; khoa ky JWT/AES lay tu secret manager, khong de chuoi/bytes literal trong code.
remediation.Java: Doc tu bien moi truong/Spring Cloud Config/Vault (@Value("${db.password}")), khong dat trong code hay file cau hinh commit len repo.
remediation.JavaScript: process.env.DB_PASSWORD (dotenv chi o moi truong dev, .env trong .gitignore); dung secret manager cua nen tang deploy.
remediation.PHP: getenv('DB_PASSWORD') hoac $_ENV; file .env ngoai webroot va trong .gitignore.
